mods.name: bananaFactory

mods.name: Better Beginning

mods.name: Better Colonies
mods.summary: Better Colonies is a lightweight colony mod that tries to emulate colonies bettering themselves through automated story point improvements. Simple as. There are also new setting.json and LunaSettings that the more experienced player can start editing in the folder. Is this save-game compatible? Yes!
mods.aiSummary: Emulates colonies improving themselves over time using automated story points, featuring enhanced tech-mining, cryorevival facilities, and a reworked administrator hiring system.

mods.name: Better Combat
mods.summary: With default settings, ships have a much faster top speed, but take much longer to accelerate to top speed. Along with this, the map size and weapon range is changed for longer range gameplay.

mods.name: Better Deserved S-Mods

mods.aiSummary: Removes default UI framing and color schemes to provide a minimalist interface with multiple color themes.

mods.name: Mining Strength Tooltips
mods.summary: Pretty much what it says on the tin, adds a reasonably convenient method of displaying mining strength (added by Nexerelin) to the player. Has LunaLib support for editing the config in-game.
mods.aiSummary: Displays mining strength values in weapon stats and expanded descriptions.

mods.name: Mirfak Parcel Service English Translation
mods.summary: Mirfak Parcel Service is a logistics company on the Hegemony's fringe. Everyone calls it neutral, non-military and friendly. They deliver anything, anywhere in the Core Worlds, from bulk commodities to a handful of personal letters.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new logistics faction and star system with unique ships, weapons, and a corporate store system.

mods.name: Mirror
mods.summary: Mirror is a simple mod that reflects most vanilla weapons, based on where they're installed on your ship. In general, weapons will be mirrored if they are to the left of the ship's centerline and facing forwards, or if they're to the right of the ship's centerline and facing backwards.
mods.aiSummary: Reflects most vanilla weapons based on their installation position relative to the ship's centerline.

mods.name: Mirrored Odyssey
mods.summary: Adds a mirrored version of the Odyssey ship with hangars on the left and main weapons on the right.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a mirrored version of the Odyssey ship with hangars on the left and main weapons on the right.

mods.name: Missile Ship Overhaul
mods.summary: This mod adds new vanilla-based ships with heavy emphasis on missile armaments, as well as four custom hullmods to the game
mods.aiSummary: Adds new vanilla-based ships with heavy emphasis on missile armaments, as well as four custom hullmods.

mods.name: Missiles and Sundry
mods.summary: Regenerating Missiles and Clip-based ballistics for vanilla Starsector. In addition to regenerating, missiles have reduced re-fire rates to stop one-shot eliminations and strange scaling with expanded missile ammo hullmod.
mods.aiSummary: Adds regenerating missiles and clip-based ballistics with adjusted refire rates to balance combat.

mods.name: Missing Drones
mods.summary: Felt like some drones were missing from the rooster. Felt like adding them. So I did. There's only two.
mods.aiSummary: Adds two missing drone types to the game.

mods.name: Missing Name Mods
mods.summary: add bunch of ship name presets into the game, Originally made & maintaned by barackollama69 and the starsector community
mods.aiSummary: Adds a collection of ship name presets to the game.

mods.name: Missing Ships Mod
mods.summary: i felt like some ships were missing from the rooster. Felt like adding them. So i did. I split the mod into 6 submods, as i know some people will prefer approach of other modders to certain factions.
mods.aiSummary: Adds numerous new capital ships, cruisers, destroyers, frigates, and fighters for various factions.

mods.name: Missing Ships Mod
mods.summary: This mod is divided into 12 submods. These submods add a combined total of 44 ships 5 Fighters 6 weapons and 3 missions to your game. Changelog inside of the modfolder.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 44 ships, 5 fighters, 6 weapons, and 3 missions across 12 submods.

mods.name: Mission Pack
mods.summary: A very large collection of missions using vanilla ships generated with MissionMaker
mods.aiSummary: Adds a large collection of missions using vanilla ships and variants.

mods.name: Missions - Renewed
mods.summary: Once your colonies earn millions a month, a 30k bar mission is not worth the trip. Missions - Renewed adds contracts in tiers 0 to 7, from pocket money to millions of credits.
mods.aiSummary: Adds tiered bar contracts ranging from small payouts to millions of credits, with various job types like hauling, combat, and smuggling.

mods.name: Mnemonic Utils
mods.summary: A mod containing exploration-themed QoL improvements. Please check the readme for details!
mods.aiSummary: Adds exploration-themed quality-of-life features such as gate markers, mnemonic sensors, trash disposal, and grid removal.

mods.name: Moar missions
mods.summary: Bunch of random 1v1 missions to practice piloting the various classes against something in the same class
mods.aiSummary: Adds various practice and campaign missions, including 1v1 piloting drills and trade defense scenarios.

mods.name: Moar XIV 2.1.2 - "We're so back" Forum Release
mods.summary: Hey hey Ladies and gents, aliens and good old organ traders. Here is the Moar XIV pack, an XIV pack that brings more XIV into the game for XIV bloat, featuring XIV. This mod adds as you can probably tell, more XIV ships to spice up your tax collecting roleplay on a bigger scale!
mods.aiSummary: Adds additional XIV faction ships with repainted sprites to expand fleet options.

mods.name: -Moci ship pack first translation-
mods.summary: This mod is the first iteration of the translation of a Fossic mod of the same name.
mods.aiSummary: Adds numerous ships, mobile suits, and Gundams from the Gundam universe in the style of ArmaArmatura's existing content.

mods.name: Mod Ships (P) Pirate
mods.summary: New ship variants
mods.aiSummary: Adds new ship variants and custom ship designs that fit the vanilla Starsector setting and gameplay.

mods.name: Mod that kills autofit
mods.summary: Requires nothing, uses a FleetInflationListener to overwrite what autofit fits
mods.aiSummary: Overwrites autofit results by copying s mods from the base fit and installing specific s mods in a defined order.

mods.name: Modern Carriers
mods.summary: Automatic Landing
mods.aiSummary: Adds automatic fighter landing, specialized carrier cores, and new hullmods to enhance carrier gameplay.

mods.name: Modified Industry Requirements
mods.summary: This small mod is aimed to expand the use area of new Special items, added in 0.95, by changing planet status requirements.
mods.aiSummary: Expands the usability of special items by modifying their planet status requirements and allowing configuration via a JSON file.

mods.name: Modular Fleet EN
mods.summary: Allows for modular ship assembly using various ship parts.
mods.aiSummary: Allows for modular ship assembly using various ship parts.

mods.name: More Bar Missions
mods.summary: A mod to increases the frequency of bar missions and ensure every market has some missions.
mods.aiSummary: Increases the frequency of bar missions and ensures every market offers some.

mods.name: More Combat Terrain Effects
mods.summary: This mod adds custom combat effect to most terrain that did not have an effect previously, as well as making campaign objectives useful in-combat.
mods.aiSummary: Adds custom combat effects to various terrains and makes campaign objectives provide benefits during battle.

mods.name: More Hullmods
mods.summary: 21 Hullmods to expand your customization options. All of them obtainable through exploration.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 21 new hullmods that can be found through exploration to customize ship performance.

mods.name: More Loot
mods.summary: A simple mod which add new items to scavenge on abandoned space stations and planet ruins. Different stations and size ruins reward different items. The items have the only practical purpose of be sold for extra cash.
mods.aiSummary: Adds unique scavengeable items to abandoned space stations and planet ruins that can be sold for extra cash.

mods.name: More Military Missions
mods.summary: A mod for adding a defense oriented bar mission.
mods.aiSummary: Adds various military missions including orbital defense, convoy escort, VIP rescue, scavenger trading, and custom bounties.

mods.name: More ProcGen Names
mods.summary: Adds 5,945 thematically-appropriate NPC and stellar object names
mods.aiSummary: Adds 5,945 new thematically-appropriate names for procedural content generation.

mods.name: More Ship Names
mods.summary: More Ship Names adds over 16,000 thematically-appropriate ship names to the name lists for ships to (randomly) select from. (15,000+ names for conventional ships, and 1,000 + 500 for REDACTED ships.)
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 16,000 thematically appropriate ship names to the random name lists for various factions and ship types.

mods.summary: More Tolerant Luddic Majority 2.0

mods.summary: This mod simply changes the Luddic Majority market condition to tolerate: Mining, Military Base, High Command

mods.name: MoreVanillaBounties
mods.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)
mods.aiSummary: Increases vanilla bounty minimums and maximums by three times and adds Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties.

mods.name: Moribund Stars
mods.summary: A story-oriented mod for Starsector. Very heavy work in progress.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a story-oriented quest chain that is currently in a heavy work-in-progress state.

mods.name: MOSS - Mod Organiser for StarSector
mods.summary: Mod installation from archives and existing mod folders. This also includes the ability to install multiple mods at once. When using the `Install from Archive` function, you can select more than one archive/zip - all of the archives you select will be installed.
mods.aiSummary: Manages Starsector mods by installing them from archives, checking for updates, and launching the game.

mods.name: moth paragon (version: moth)
mods.summary: moth on the paragon
mods.aiSummary: Adds a moth-themed paragon ship.

mods.name: MrDavidoff´s Ship Addon

mods.aiSummary: Provides a collection of ship sprites and weapons for use in other mods.

mods.name: Multiplayer Video Submissions, SSMP

mods.name: Musashi Manufactorum
mods.summary: Meet your beloved Battleships from WW2 in space!
mods.aiSummary: Adds World War II-themed battleships and high-alpha weapons with specialized targeting and ammo feeder systems.

mods.name: Music Switcher
mods.summary: Music Switcher lets you decide what music plays, when, and for whom — without touching your save file.
mods.aiSummary: Lets players choose which music tracks play for specific factions and situations via a settings panel, including custom combat themes.

mods.name: MvM skinpack.

mods.aiSummary: Adds a Mann vs Machine inspired paintjob pack for derelict ships.

mods.name: My Little Pony

mods.name: N84PhasePack
mods.summary: Small Mod Pack for Phase stuff
mods.aiSummary: Adds various hullmods and weapons focused on phase cloak mechanics, including cost reductions, speed boosts, and tactical phasers.

mods.name: Nadekoverse, a portrait mod
mods.summary: Made for personal use, I present to you: Nadekoverse. This is my first mod for Starsector. It contains 101 previous profile pictures I made for myself of the exact same character with the exact same album art in the background.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 101 portrait images of a single anime character, grouped by faction based on outfit.

mods.name: NavalSector (On Hold)
mods.summary: Adds in many WW2 Naval Ships on the US side and my personal faction inspired by French stuff. (Was going to have 1.0 have atleast have Germany and Japan but lol)
mods.aiSummary: Adds World War II naval ships, two factions, star systems, and related hullmods and weapons.

mods.name: Navarchy of Tania
mods.summary: A nation forged in despair and war, that survived the Luddic Church mayhem. The Navarchy of Tania succeeds on fast paced combat, constantly changing positions and pushing enemies from multiple directions.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction focused on resilient, mobile ships that win by outlasting enemies through strong armor and efficient shields.

mods.name: NebuLib
mods.summary: For users: This utility / library mod is used in my mods and therefor required to be installed along with them.
mods.aiSummary: Provides utility classes for retrieving logical string IDs of campaign entities like planets, stars, and stations.

mods.name: NEON's ship pack (v3.0.5.8)
mods.summary: A Vanilla+ Ship Pack which adds a curated selection of vessels to the main factions of the sector, alongside adding onto existing vanilla exploration content.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a curated selection of vessels to the main factions and expands on existing vanilla exploration content.

mods.name: Neoteric Advent
mods.summary: Presenting the arrival of a new era, this mod offers a collection of ships, weapons, hullmods and exploration content, related to in-game events which happen near to cycle 206. Can be added mid-save, star systems and fleet goods will spawn after loading the game.
mods.aiSummary: Adds ships, weapons, hullmods, and exploration content tied to events near cycle 206.

mods.name: Nerf Arms Dealers 1.0.1
mods.summary: as the mod says it NERFS ARMS DEALERS -
mods.aiSummary: Nerfs high-importance arms dealers to make their offerings more consistent with lower tiers.

mods.name: Nes's SAW
mods.summary: Ships with cosmetic Skins. Splendid! Includes:
mods.aiSummary: Adds custom ships, weapons, portraits, and paintjobs, including shiny salvage variants and exploration content.

mods.name: Neutrino Corp.
mods.summary: These are strange designs by other faction's standards, but this is the fruit of Neutrino corps engineering, trading flux capacity for more armor and dissipation rates.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with heavy, armor-focused ships and unique energy weapons.

mods.name: Neutrino Detector Mk.II
mods.summary: Adds a new ability that removes false spikes at an increased volatiles cost.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new ability that removes false spikes from the neutrino detector at an increased volatiles cost.

mods.name: Neutrino Detector On-Screen Display
mods.summary: Description: While Neutrino Detector is active, an OSD will show up near the hotbar listing detected entities that are not currently shown on the map. Configurable to show faction and distance, can be placed beside or above the hotbar, can be set to only show fleets while Sensor Burst is active.
mods.aiSummary: Displays detected entities not shown on the map in a configurable on-screen display when Neutrino Detector is active.

mods.name: New Beginnings
mods.summary: New Beginnings makes it more interesting (and less painful) to die.
mods.aiSummary: Generates a new fleet worth about half of your lost ships when you lose everything, outfitted with your unlocked equipment.

mods.name: New Game Plus - Renewed
mods.summary: Every level you gain, in any save, earns career points. Every new game opens a store next to your starting fleet where those points buy a head start: story points, skill points, levels, credits, supplies and more.
mods.aiSummary: Earns career points from leveling up in any save, which can be spent on starting bonuses in new games.

mods.name: Nexerelin
mods.summary: 4X game features in Starsector
mods.aiSummary: Adds 4X strategy elements including faction wars, diplomacy, colony management, and dynamic sector generation.

mods.name: Nexerelin Queued 1.1.0/DEFUNCT
mods.summary: So, with histidine's permission, I've queued all non-essential intel of Nexerelin. No more incessant intel spam in the outer rim! (NOTE: All player agent intel is added for functionality.) The Nexerelin 0.9.8 version will be in the NEXT nexerelin update. When that happens, this post will be deleted.
mods.aiSummary: Queues most Nexerelin intel so it is only received when near a comm relay.

mods.name: Nexus
mods.summary: This mini mod adds small fleets of aggressive AI ships into Corvus, which are at war with everyone. Avoid them early on.
mods.aiSummary: Adds small fleets of aggressive AI ships into Corvus that are at war with everyone.

mods.name: Night At Derinkuyu
mods.summary: Night At Derinkuyu is intended to be a story-oriented mod focusing on the relatively unimportant Derinkuyu Mining Station.
mods.aiSummary: Adds two short quests and an independent underworld contact with custom dialogue to the Derinkuyu Mining Station.

mods.name: Nightcross Armory Corporation
mods.summary: This is a faction I've been working on for some time. I first started modding back in 2019, before going on hiatus and coming back around 0.97, at which point I found out to my amazement that my source code mostly still worked!
mods.aiSummary: Adds a high-tech faction with fast, shielded ships, specialized weapons, and unique hullmods that trade flux dissipation for capacity.

mods.name: Nightcross Armory Corporation
mods.summary: This is a faction I've been working on for some time. I first started modding back in 2019, before going on hiatus and coming back around 0.97, at which point I found out to my amazement that my source code mostly still worked!
mods.aiSummary: Adds a high-tech minor faction with unique ships, weapons, and exploration content, including abyss encounters and a star system with independent markets.

mods.name: Nijigen Extend || Standalone Pack || Update 08/31 [YREX]
mods.summary: This mod is an standalone expansion pack for Yuri Expedition and Arian Empire. It contains the strange ideas I come up with that are either larger than either mod, or are silly and don't belong. These features include:
mods.aiSummary: Adds utility weapons, forge ships, criminal industries, and a tech cooperative market as a standalone expansion.

mods.name: Niko's Scavengable Industries 1.0.0
mods.summary: Adds a number (eleven, currently) of industries obtainable through looting, markets, and raiding!
mods.aiSummary: Adds eleven industries obtainable through looting, markets, and raiding that fill niche roles.

mods.name: Niko's SWP 1.1.1
mods.summary: Just a bunch of weapons I made that I thought were cool but couldn't find anywhere to put them. Weighted pretty low so its rare you'll see any of them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a collection of rare, low-weight custom weapons including shielded missiles and shield projectors.

mods.name: NiteLib v1.1.0 [Update I]
mods.summary: QOL library mod to no longer search and write out string id's.
mods.aiSummary: Provides utility classes for modders to retrieve vanilla string IDs and variables without manual searching.

mods.name: No Such Organization
mods.summary: A minor faction with historic ties to Tri-Tachyon Corp and a love of phase ships. 'No Such Organization' is an open secret, rebranding after the Hegemony destroyed the bases of the PHASEOPS 3rd Task Force in the end of AI Wars. Nowadays, they salvage available hulls and shove phase coils in them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a minor faction focused on salvaged phase ships, featuring unique vessels, hullmods, and Nexerelin integration.

mods.name: Nomad Flotilla
mods.summary: Create your own migrant nomad flotilla attached to your fleet, travelling through the stars!
mods.aiSummary: Adds a migrant population to your fleet that utilizes ship space for production and construction.

mods.name: Nomadic Survival
mods.summary: Nomadic Survival makes exploration more interesting by adding sites to planets that allow you to perform various operations. It's a mod about crafting the resources you need instead of returning home to restock.
mods.aiSummary: Adds planetary operation sites for crafting resources and an optional anomaly mechanic that limits fuel tanker utility.

mods.name: Nomadic Survival Addon - Wonders from Beyond
mods.summary: Wonders From Beyond is an addon mod that adds 25+ New Plantetary Operations, all of which are very profitable. They encourage a play style where hauling all sorts of resources is rewarded. That 4k heavy machinery you have collected over time from battles?
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 25 profitable planetary operations that reward hauling various resources, including new commodities and high-value extraction sites.

mods.name: Novum Agrum Extractions
mods.summary: A independent mining company turned into a vengeful conglomerate after getting pushed out of the core worlds due to their supposed intense rivalry and corporate warfare. They are specialized in converting midline civilian ships into improvised combat vessels capable of self defense.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction, Novum Agrum Extractions, featuring mining and salvage ships converted into combat vessels, along with custom weapons and star systems.

mods.name: NPC SMods
mods.summary: Realistic s-modding because if you can do it why shouldnt others.
mods.aiSummary: Allows AI fleets to acquire and keep S-mods based on fleet size and officer levels, with configurable probabilities for specific hullmods.

mods.name: Nuclear Weapons!
mods.summary: This mod adds nuclear weapons that deal incredible amounts of damage (unrealistic but who cares). It is included in the missile package bp.
mods.aiSummary: Adds nuclear weapons that deal massive damage, including a 30 Megaton ICBM.

mods.name: Nyan Cat Mod
mods.summary: This mod adds the Nyan Cat Faction to the campaign, they spawn the first day on the far left of the map and they help you attacking the pirates (this can change if you think it's better otherwise) for now there is only one ship, the normal Nyan Cat and one tipe of fleet, the scout.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction that spawns on the far left of the map and helps attack pirates.

mods.name: Oak Brotherhood 0.91a (Beta)
mods.summary: Oak Brotherhood is a Faction that resides in abyssal hyperspace, near mysterious green star called "Quercus". It has 3 planets. Oak Brotherhood is made of 2 groups. Scientists - Scientists, engineers, archeologists.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Oak Brotherhood faction, featuring tanky high-tech ships designed for ramming attacks and unique weapons.

mods.name: Objects Analysis 002
mods.summary: An ability to detects all possible non planetary objects that can reflected by Neutrino Detector within range, but doesn't give you the location. I have been using this for myself a few years now. You still need to use Neutrino Detector if you want to pin point the object.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an ability that detects all non-planetary objects within Neutrino Detector range without revealing their specific locations.

mods.name: Obsidian Void (ASC: B5) (DOM: D2)
mods.summary: Take control of the Lemurian Fleet as an immortal admiral, and fight against the Terran Dominion for your civilization's survival.
mods.aiSummary: Lets you take control of the Lemurian Fleet as an immortal admiral to fight against the Terran Dominion for your civilization's survival.

mods.name: Obtainable Shroud & Threat
mods.summary: Construct "sane" versions of shroud and threat vessels using the Shrouded Substrate menu.
mods.aiSummary: Adds balanced, obtainable versions of Shroud and Threat vessels with modified stats and built-in hullmods.

mods.name: Obvious Neutron
mods.summary: Changes the campaign map icon for Neutron Stars to make them more obvious.
mods.aiSummary: Makes neutron stars easier to spot on the campaign map by changing their icons.

mods.name: Oddish's Crash Logger
mods.summary: This is just an extra crash information logger that I vibecoded for debugging another mod's development. I have since deleted the code as it was quite useless, but then later on claude told me that it actually WAS useful. I'm putting it up here as a mod if anyone wants to use it. It saves way more information about the game, mostly for LLM's to understand what went wrong. It's just an enormous dump of whatever I can dump, pretty much.
mods.aiSummary: Dumps extensive game state and crash details into a text file for analysis by large-context LLMs.

mods.name: Officer Extendedest
mods.summary: Simple officer respecs. Safe to add or remove to ongoing saves. Compatible with officer extension.

mods.aiSummary: Overhauls the officer selection dialog to allow managing unlimited officers, suspending them for a fee, demoting them to reset levels, and filtering by custom tags.

mods.name: Oga Portrait Pack

mods.name: Omega's Minimash .54 compatible Thanks to xenoargh

mods.name: OMM - Freitag Corporation

mods.name: Omnifactory

mods.name: Outer Rim Alliance

mods.name: Parlay "Giving the pirates more" 0.8, Uomoz corvus compatible!

mods.name: Particle Engine
mods.summary: A library that implements a stateless, instanced particle system.

mods.name: PatchLib
mods.summary: PatchLib is a library mod that enables bytecode patching at runtime for starsector. To install it, simply drop the mod in to your mods folder like other mods. Only install it if a mod requires it.

mods.name: PatrolsGoAway

mods.name: Per class limits

mods.name: Perilous Expanse
mods.summary: In the base game, all you need to easily access the entire map is a single, cheap fuel tanker. This mod changes that by making resource management and survival an integral part of exploration.

mods.name: Persean Chronicles

mods.name: Pirate Collection

mods.aiSummary: Replaces the vanilla planetary shield with a less overbearing design that shows the planet beneath better while retaining the red aesthetic.

mods.name: Planetary Shield: Access Control
mods.summary: This is a mini-mod that changes the mechanics of the planetary shield generator; I found that, with its vanilla implementation, I never actually wanted to use it - so I modified it to offer an additional option to help deal with Pather terrorists.

mods.name: Plasma Burn Escape

mods.name: Random Sector

mods.name: Random Weapon Collection

mods.name: Rebalance and CTD fix for gundam UC

mods.name: Red

mods.name: Tesseract Prototype
mods.summary: Ever wanted to fly a Tesseract? well now you can!This mod lets the player make and fly the tesseract. it does have the shard spawner hull mod removed, so when it dies it will not spawn new ships like usual there is no way around that. Also all stats are left unchanged and its 500k to build
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Tesseract ship with a blueprint that is available instantly.

mods.name: The Abyss Stares Back [1.1]
mods.summary: Gives the shrouded eye a laser pointer that instills fear in any ship it touches, causing them to back away. This may make shrouded fights easier, depending on whether or not you are running ships that could otherwise just facetank the eye. Comes in two flavors, one with a visible targeting laser (I SEE YOU), one without
mods.aiSummary: Adds a fear-inducing laser pointer to the Shrouded Eye, causing ships it touches to back away.

mods.name: The Abyssal War
mods.summary: The Threat (vanilla's abyssal fabricator swarm) colonises the fringe of the sector, grows, and invades the core worlds
mods.aiSummary: Adds a persistent alien invasion where the player manages a ground war against hive colonies using marines, bombardment, and blockade strategies.

mods.name: The Apocrita Association
mods.summary: The Apocrita Association is a small faction mod with a handful of ships, several being focused on built-in weapons.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a small faction with 14 ships, pirate and Persean League variants, non-built-in weapons, fighters, and high-value bounties.

mods.name: The Automated Menace official release
mods.summary: Adds a faction of automated ships including fighters, frigates, destroyers, cruisers, and capital ships.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of automated ships including fighters, frigates, destroyers, cruisers, and capital ships.

mods.name: The Confederacy of Free Stars
mods.summary: Anyway, the Confederacy of Free Stars is one idea I've been holding in my head since I was 12. I'm 16 now, and it's gone through various revisions and such. I'm trying to adapt the CFS to Starfarer lore, though I may plan a total conversion once Starfarer is developed enough.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction with custom ships and campaign integration based on the Battleships Forever ship maker.

mods.name: The Corporate Collection (A collection of mods)
mods.summary: The corporate collection is a collection of popular and good mods.
mods.aiSummary: Bundles several popular faction mods into a single download.

mods.name: The Domain Reformed
mods.summary: A hyper-reactionary faction mod for those with a love of the past
mods.aiSummary: Adds a hyper-reactionary faction obsessed with restoring the old Domain, featuring a military-industrial economy and a dictator-led government.

mods.name: The Enforcers - Spess Police
mods.summary: After a short while of developing, I think it's time to release the mod to the world - The Enforcers, an organized group of vigilantes with one set goal. Ridding Corvus of criminal scum.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an organized group of vigilantes dedicated to ridding Corvus of criminal scum.

mods.name: The Eusan Nation (from Signalis)
mods.summary: The Eusan Nation is an independent star system, existing in the Persean Sector in a precarious state. Since the Gate system shutdown, the star system has been in a constant state of change.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Eusan Nation, a faction and star system set in the Persean Sector with unique ships, lore, and gameplay elements based on the game Signalis.

mods.name: The Everything Shop
mods.summary: Somewhere in hyperspace hides a nebula called the Gate of Babylon. Its stations sell everything: every hull, weapon, fighter wing, AI core, special item, blueprint and modspec from every mod you have installed. It is a cheat mod. Prices are steep, but nothing is out of reach.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a nebula with stations that sell every hull, weapon, fighter wing, AI core, and special item from all installed mods.

mods.name: The Exar War (new system dynamic war mod) WIP Beta release
mods.summary: My latest attempt at freshening up the game without adding any new art assets (lord knows I suck at those).
mods.aiSummary: Replaces Corvus with the Exar system and introduces a dynamic war mechanic between the Exar Navy and Hegemony.

mods.name: The Gedune - - Get Up! - Working DEV
mods.summary: A race borne from the ashes of a fallen empire. The Gedune were once one of the most powerful races of man to ever roam the stars. Now they are little more than scavengers and pirates, but even in their death throes the Gedune are a force not to be taken lightly.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Gedune faction, featuring agile ships with high frontal firepower and flux capacity but fragile hulls and weak point defense.

mods.name: The Gekelonians Technocracy demo
mods.summary: The Gekelonian people, once gathered in the Lonia system now scattered across the galaxy. They lived ages in the Lonia system after stranded there due to a failed wormhole experiment.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of knowledge-seeking aliens with unique ships and missions focused on gathering technology.

mods.name: The Hagan Protestants (Beta/in need of playtesting)
mods.summary: A big old faction mod I've been hammering away at on and off for about a year now that's finally ready for some proper playtesting.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a luddic church colony faction with 28 ships, 12 weapons, and unique hullmods.

mods.name: The Hoplites of Corinth
mods.summary: The Hoplites' theme is based on the concept that was used by Ancient Greek city-states. These City-states employed citizen-soldiers as defence, which I have transfered to the future theme. This faction is the guardians of the trading & mining planet, apropriately named Corinth.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a Greek-themed faction with a militia of citizen-soldiers defending a trading and mining planet.

mods.name: The Interwars Alliance [The Hegemony Haters]
mods.summary: First of all, you can consider this faction like it was a player faction that got fed up with the Hegemony and their annoying AI Inspections, raids, and never-ending warmongering.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a militaristic faction that relies on heavily armored capital ships and raw firepower to wage war against the Hegemony.

mods.name: The Invisible Hand
mods.summary: The Invisible Hand is a high-tech fleet command protocol that automates the "boring" parts of sector domination. Recovered from a databank in a defunct Tri-Tachyon black site, this mod allows you to license and commission autonomous Merchant Detachments.
mods.aiSummary: Automates trade logistics for Nexerelin Special Task Groups by enabling autonomous merchant detachments that buy low and sell high.

mods.name: The Knights of Ludd
mods.summary: An ambitious expansion for the sector's holy defenders and their unholy enemies.
mods.aiSummary: Adds hand-crafted star systems, boss fights, custom AI, and a campaign storyline with modular armor and primitive shielding mechanics.

mods.name: The Last Fight
mods.summary: This is just a little mod for those who have done all the challenge in the campaign and want something for their über fleet to chew on. (compatible for starfarer v0.52a)
mods.aiSummary: Unifies all factions in the current system into a single massive enemy fleet targeting the player.

mods.name: The Lion's Guard 0.03e (Now Redundant)
mods.summary: This mod simply added Lion's Guard skins to Sindrian Diktat and Lion's Guard ships. It's now been folded into Ship and Weapon Pack, HERE. However, this mod is really simple, so I'm keeping it up for first-time modders to copy-paste-despair from it.
mods.aiSummary: Adds Lion's Guard skins to Sindrian Diktat and Lion's Guard ships.

mods.name: The Lotus Conglomerate :: Intrepid to the grave!!...T_T
mods.summary: Here is the second official version of the Lotus Conglomerate Pirates mod. It introduces a new planet to the Corvus system(Called Synchrony) with a station dealing heavily in contraband, convoy and flotilla operations, as well as a hard(ish) mission to showcase the faction arsenal.
mods.aiSummary: Introduces a pirate faction with new ships, weapons, and a contraband station in the Corvus system.

mods.name: The Mayorate
mods.summary: Widely condemned in most political circles, the Mayorate is a small, isolationist star nation bordering the core worlds. Baseline humans play little to no role in government and economic activities - state affairs have been dictated by the Mayor, an AI of unknown capabilities, since the Collapse.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an isolationist star nation led by an AI, featuring new ships, weapons, fighters, and a unique high-flux combat style.

mods.name: the mod that closes your game when it opens
mods.summary: inspired by the hit celeste mod! 10 billion downloads
mods.aiSummary: Closes the game immediately upon opening.

mods.name: THE MOD THAT INCONSISTANTLY CRASHES YOUR GAME
mods.summary: Ever want to experience what it's like to play in an unstable modding scene, but all the modern mods are too dang stable? Well, with the low low price of 0.00$, you too can experience what its like to play an unstable modlist with INCONSISTENT CRASHES, based on certain actions you may take! Guaranteed frustration, keyboard smashes, and HOURS of progress lost! NO WARRANTIES.
mods.aiSummary: Causes the game to crash inconsistently based on certain player actions.

mods.name: The Mod That Sometimes Crashes Your Game
mods.summary: Fun, immersive, and engaging! Unpredictability creates an exciting experience.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a mod that sometimes crashes the game to create an unpredictable experience.

mods.name: The Nihilic Empire
mods.summary: Three missions - Damn hard
mods.aiSummary: Adds a hostile faction with seven ships, various weapons, and three challenging missions to the campaign.

mods.name: The Nomads
mods.summary: This mod adds a new faction, The Nomads, to the game with custom ships and weapons. They are universally hostile, except to the player and the other neutral or independent factions. The Armada Fleet will depart from the Nur system and journey around the sector for as long as it can.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a universally hostile faction with custom ships and weapons that roam the sector from the Nur system.

mods.name: [0.98a] The Orbiting Spoon - A Space Diner & Officer Social Mod - WIP
mods.displayName: The Orbiting Spoon - A Space Diner & Officer Social Mod
mods.summary: The Orbiting Spoon is a lightweight, text-based roleplay and campaign layer mod that adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports across the Persean Sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports, offering faction-specific meals and social interactions.

mods.name: The Patrian Principate
mods.summary: Patria is a yellow star system home to a terran-class planet, home of the fledgling Patrian Principate. A small settlement started hundreds of years before the collapse, it has grown over the years and has developed a distinct culture largely revolving around archives of Old Earth.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Patrian Principate faction, featuring Terrestrial-Orbital vessels and aerospace fighters with distinct naval-inspired designs and logistics-heavy gameplay.

mods.name: The Phoenix
mods.summary: Ship Mod - Frigate - Adds The Phoenix to your starting fleet. The picture was taken from the "Tyrian 2000" game. Fragile but powerful, it's a little miracle worker whose best aspect is its tiny size!
mods.aiSummary: Adds The Phoenix frigate to the starting fleet, a fragile but powerful ship with a tiny size.

mods.aiSummary: Adds the Phoenix Prototype experimental cruiser to the starting fleet, bringing considerable firepower to the battlefield.

mods.name: The Positron faction mod - w/ campaign - mod pretty much cancelled

This is an early test version, but it aims at giving a good impression never-the-less. However, because it is a test version balance issues and the like may arise.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction called the Positrons, a matching orbital station, and 21 unique ships to the campaign.

mods.name: The Qualljom Society [Exerelin compatible with extra download]
mods.summary: They are a bunch of scientists, engineers, technicians and adventurers dedicated to exploration and techmining. They started as a scientific exploration and had to settle at some distant starsystem, Holotis, where they developed into the group they are today.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of scientists and explorers with unique ships and weapons derived from core-world tech.

mods.name: The rebels (GSB faction mod)

mods.aiSummary: Adds a 10-ship faction and a station orbiting Corvus IV as their main base.

mods.name: The Red Tempest

mods.aiSummary: Adds the Red Tempest frigate to the starting fleet, equipped with two modded super weapons and a special mission.
mods.partOfThreadTitle: MOD - The LARGE MOD collection. Adding new graphics to Starfarer. (85 mods)

mods.name: The Rising Sun V .06, NOW WITH CAMPAIGN
mods.summary: The rising sun came from another galaxy, most likely displaced by the second galaxy war. They have no fighters because their "fighters" are so large that by all standards the would be considered frigates. Their ships are fast and strong.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of fast and strong ships from another galaxy, including seven vessels and campaign implementation.

mods.name: The Scourge
mods.summary: Adds a mission to showcase 5 new biological ships with 6 new biological weapons (with zerg sounds provided by WarStalker).
mods.aiSummary: Adds missions featuring five biological ships and six biological weapons.

mods.name: The Scrappers Faction! (Mod , .54a) Very minor tweaks
mods.summary: With help from Paul's tutorial and Redbull's ship editor, I managed to "scrap" together some ships with existing sprites and make a faction!
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with unique ships, weapons, and missions featuring high armor and ballistic-only combat.

mods.name: The Second Battlegroup
mods.summary: The Second Battlegroup is an elite line of ships that can be found as derelict outside of the Core Systems (Like XIV Legion). But for gameplay purposes, their blueprint can also be found individually.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an elite line of capital ships, auxiliary vessels, fighters, and weapons focused on overwhelming frontal firepower.

mods.name: The Shadow Order (v.60, .54a) New Hullmod. .54a
mods.summary: The Shadow Order has a base in the top right corner. It doesn't sell anything but a contract, which when bought, will cause the Shadow Order to become neutral to you and the other factions become hostile.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction with unique ships, weapons, and missions featuring hand-drawn graphical assets.

mods.name: The Silent Armada
mods.summary: Three cycles ago, they arrived. A Hegemony outer system patrol was the first to pick them up on long-range scanners. A silent armada of unknown, unregistered spacecraft pushing their way through Hyperspace.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of uncrewed, autonomous warships with unique hull and flux systems focused on broadside combat.

mods.name: The Star Federation (Based on FTL)
mods.summary: The Star Federation sought the same thing many other rebels wanted: freedom from the Domain of Man's brutal and ambitious rule.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction inspired by FTL with specialized ships featuring high-performance hulls and unique shield mechanics.

mods.name: The Storm Prototype
mods.summary: Ship Mod - Cruiser - Adds the Storm Prototype to your starting fleet. The sprite was taken from the "Tyrian 2000" game. A experimental fast cruiser that brings considerable firepower to the battlefield.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Storm Prototype experimental fast cruiser to the starting fleet, bringing considerable firepower to the battlefield.

mods.name: The Tau Manta

mods.aiSummary: Adds a Tau Manta inspired cruiser to the starting fleet, featuring missile mounts that make it a dangerous opponent.

mods.name: The Tellasian League
mods.summary: Faction Description
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with unique ships, a refit hullmod, and an AI Switch hullmod that allows ships to be crewed by either human or AI captains.

mods.name: The TimCORP Mod (Version 1.6,we need a new spriter, works with .52a)
mods.summary: A advanced empire, utilizing the latest technology to their advantage against all their enemies, seeking destruction of their archenemies, the alliance, but aren't so willingy to form alliances with the other factions. As of current, they are hostile against them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds an advanced empire faction with unique ships and weapons that is hostile to other factions.

mods.name: The Traversers' Design Bureau
mods.summary: The Traverser's Association is a group of exiles from other worlds who set out to survive, having previously been part of a large mercenary group under the Independents.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of exiled mercenaries offering warships and weapons with strong shield resistance and missile focus.

mods.name: The Utopian Empire (0.5 released)
mods.summary: The Utopian Empire approaches.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with four ships, nine weapons, and a mission to test them.

mods.name: The Vass
mods.summary: Since it is christmastime, i figured i should finally unveil the small project i have been developing for about two years: the Vass.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a collection of time-manipulating ships and weapons that appear in Independent fleets rather than as a separate faction.

mods.name: TheDarkSix - Ship & Weapons Pack (EN Translation)
mods.summary: My poor second translation attempt of a great CN super ship mod.
mods.aiSummary: Adds super dreadnoughts, fighters, weapons, and hullmods for core factions, along with reskinned ship systems.

mods.name: TheDarkSix Ship & Weapon Pack (aka TDS) 1.73-HF3 (UPD 30.06.26)
mods.summary: Chinasector mod translated into english. Features all kinds of boats, from frigates to supercapitals. Weapons range from rather underpowered to good damage dealers.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a variety of ships from frigates to supercapitals, along with weapons and hullmods.

mods.name: There Be Juggernauts
mods.summary: Just some silly ships that aren't easily acceptable in the current game or at least makes the experience more terrible to the unfortunate users. Oh, and expected vanilla factions will get them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds oversized, unbalanced capital ships and juggernauts to vanilla factions.

mods.name: thgualsnO bounty for Vayra's Sector
mods.summary: A working example of how to implement a custom ship as a unique bounty minimod for use with Vayra's Sector
mods.aiSummary: Provides a working example for implementing custom ships as unique bounties, featuring a meme reverse onslaught ship.

mods.name: ThirstSector - A Complete Portrait Replacer
mods.summary: ThirstSector is a complete portrait replacer for all generic and named characters in the base game. ThirstSector is available as a SFW mod with an optional NSFW expansion. All images were generated by machine learning and then edited manually.
mods.aiSummary: Replaces portraits for all generic and named characters with AI-generated, manually edited images.

mods.name: Thog's [REDACTED] - More Remnant Drones
mods.summary: Currently, the mod adds a total of 13 different new remnant drone ships, along with six fighter wings and six weapons, including a number of hybrid-mount energy-based flak weapons and a small-slot single Dragonfire DEM.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 13 new remnant drone ships, six fighter wings, and six weapons including hybrid-mount energy flak and a Dragonfire DEM.

mods.name: Thog's Domain - More Explorarium Drones
mods.summary: Have All The Domain Drones+, but still want MORE domain drones? Want to fight a comically large, multi-part drone ship designed by an AI with pulsar-induced alzheimers? Or maybe you want the exact opposite - a tiny, multi-part miniwall to bolster your own Explorarium-themed fleet?
mods.aiSummary: Adds 29 new Explorarium drone ships, seven fighter wings, and four new weapons.

mods.name: Thorough System Scan(was System Wide Sensor Scan) EN translation
mods.summary: ### Adds an initially available campaign ability that allows the player to perform a %u201CSystem-Scale Sensor Burst%u201D after a number of prerequisites have been met in order to discover salvage-worthy objects in the current star system and temporarily have a view of all fleets in the star system.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a campaign ability to scan an entire star system for salvage and fleet locations at the cost of volatiles and combat readiness.

mods.name: THREAT DETECTED
mods.summary: silly little sidbar plugin that helps locating threat fleets only enabled enabled after finding the onslaught mk1, or obtaining threat detection mem flag through other means only active when panel is added to sidebar, remove panel to turn it off when active will check current system for any threat fleets in it will beep at you if there are any in system will beep faster the closer you are to any of them only tracks one closest fleet at a time
mods.aiSummary: Adds a sidebar plugin that beeps to alert the player when threat fleets are present in the current system.

mods.name: THREAT DETECTED
mods.summary: ||THREAT DETECTED|| ||THREAT DETECTED||
mods.aiSummary: Adds a challenging fleet encounter featuring Fabricators that explode if more than two are present.

mods.name: Threat Start
mods.summary: Three mods that add Derelict custom start, Remnant custom start, Omega custom start & Threat custom start and put the player under their commission
mods.aiSummary: Adds a custom start where the player is commissioned by the Threat faction and can interact with the Threat fleet.
mods.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98a] [WIP] Derelict Start, Remnant Start, Omega Start & Threat Start

mods.name: THREAT TECH
mods.summary: These ships have a uncommon chance to spawn in Threat Fleets in the Abyss, and may be recoverable after they are disabled and the battle is won. Occasionally, Fabricator slots may be taken by the capitals, which in rare cases will make some fights significantly easier.
mods.aiSummary: Adds upgraded low-tech Threat ships and weapons that can spawn in Abyss fleets or be forged after completing a special bounty.

mods.name: Thule Legacy
mods.summary: This is an update and slight remake of the original Thule Legacy mod by Thule (http://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=3369.0), with permission from him to work on the mod.
mods.aiSummary: Updates and remakes the original Thule Legacy faction, adding ships with shields and adjusting balance stats.

mods.name: Thunder's Flag Pack
mods.summary: A mod that adds random flags for all your colony-making needs
mods.aiSummary: Adds random flags for colony-making needs.

mods.name: Tiandong Heavy Industries
mods.summary: Tiandong Heavy Industries is a powerful mercenary organization and trade conglomerate, established in the outskirts of the Sector following the Great Collapse.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a mercenary faction with seventeen ship classes, six fighter wings, and eleven modular weapons, featuring a retrofitting service that converts vanilla and modded hulls into Tiandong versions.

mods.name: Tiangong Ship Design Bureau English Translation
mods.summary: When the Gates went dark, four Domain institutions in the Persean Sector were left on their own: the Deep Space Strategy Bureau, the Persean Ordnance Depository (known as the Armory), the Tiangong Creation Bureau's research institute, and Xihe Heavy Industries.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new major faction with over 40 ships, unique weapons, and a War Merit economy system.

mods.name: Tidy.Panels
mods.summary: QOL UI fixes, starting with the market / cargo list.
mods.aiSummary: Collapses cargo buttons to save space and extends them on hover to fix UI alignment issues.

mods.name: Tinyverse - The Wanzer Age
mods.summary: With the introduction of Diable Avionics into the sector and their military successes thanks to reintroducing the long abandoned technology of Wanzers, giant piloted mechanized robots capable of fighting both in-planet and out in the vacuum of space, showcased that it was time to consider the era of dominance of the spaceship and fighters had come to an end. Factions all over the sector have scrambled to bring back old, forgotten relics out of the dusty hangars where they had been forgotten. Others have used their ample monetary resources to acquire Wanzer blueprints and schematics from both legal and more illicit means, and others have straight-up used their vast production powers to jumpstart their Wanzer development programs. A new arms race has begun.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 18 Wanzer frames and wings for all vanilla factions, including unique mass-production variants and rare ace pilot wings.

mods.name: Tolerant Luddic Majority
mods.summary: Ever feel like your Luddic faithful are just too picky? Worlds that are harsh, polluted, or missing a few farms shouldn’t ruin a colony’s harmony?
mods.aiSummary: Lets Luddic populations tolerate harsh worlds, pollution, and industrial hubs they would normally reject.

mods.name: Too Much Information
mods.summary: Too Much Information is a beta, but stable mod that displays more information on your ship, weapons, and wings! It can be added to a current save, but cannot be safely removed. (unless you pretty much remove all the hullmods from your ships)
mods.aiSummary: Displays detailed statistics for ships, wings, projectiles, beams, and missiles in their info cards.

mods.name: Torched Seeker 1.0c (Unofficial Fork of Torchships and Seeker)
mods.summary: (Please check the message at the bottom of the thread before downloading)
mods.aiSummary: Merges content from Torchships and Seeker while introducing various modifications.

mods.name: Torchships and Deadly Armaments
mods.summary: A small-ish collection of ships wings and weapons focusing on seamless integration next to the vanilla game. This isn't the flashiest or the deadliest of the content mods around, but it should hopefully provide some interesting variations and combinations to the vanilla factions fleets.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a collection of ships, wings, and weapons designed for seamless integration with vanilla factions.

mods.name: Torchships and Deadly Armaments Unofficial Update
mods.summary: An unofficial update bringing Tartiflette's mod, Torchships and Deadly Armaments, to 0.98. Credit to Tartiflette as this is simply an unofficial update for one of his mods. Credit as well to Maxwell and Slavodan for the Owl (XIV) sprite added in this fork.
mods.aiSummary: Updates the Torchships and Deadly Armaments content for version 0.98, including buffs to ships like the Herald and adjustments to stats and spawn weights.

mods.name: Tore Up Plenty
mods.summary: Vanilla Friendly Alternate Starting Ships
mods.aiSummary: Adds 58 new ships, custom variants, a new faction, and alternate starting ship options.

mods.name: Touhou Quest [0.98a]

mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction and questline based on Touhou Project, featuring unique ships, fighters, weapons, and visual novel elements.

mods.name: Trade Scavengers - Now with Fanciness!
mods.summary: The Trade Scavengers history begins with the city world of Roche III, better known as Avarice. It was a rare planet, being a border world yet fully metropolised, and such had a flourishing economy, albeit with less regulation on goods than the core worlds.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of traders who seized an industrial center and retrofitted commercial vessels into combat ships.

mods.name: Tradewinds
mods.summary: This mod adds a variety of commodities that can be carried from place to place across the sector. All of the (two) core systems are supported, along with a variety of additional systems, and each system has a different set of prices for certain goods.
mods.aiSummary: Adds tradeable commodities with system-specific prices and roaming cargo fleets.

mods.name: Tradewinds II
mods.summary: So this is a development and eventually release thread for a trading and economy focussed mod which should add a few new features and skills, intended to make non-combat professions more interesting and something you can specialize in, along with enabling other non-combat professions other than trading (most notably scavenging at present).
mods.aiSummary: Adds debris clouds containing excess loot from defeated fleets, allowing players to scavenge remnants before they dissipate.

mods.name: Tradução PT-BR do Starsector (Português do Brasil)
mods.summary: Tradução de 24.746 textos: diálogos, missões, descrições, dicas, habilidades, menus e Codex.
mods.aiSummary: Translates Starsector 0.98.5a-RC4 into Brazilian Portuguese, covering over 24,000 text entries and updating game fonts for accent support.

mods.name: Trailer Moments
mods.summary: Trailer Moments is a small eyecandy mod that adds Nicke's MagicTrails to a handful of vanilla weapon projectiles. It fulfills no practical purpose besides making some weapons look subjectively prettier and as such isn't recommended to use if you have trouble running Starsector on your computer.
mods.aiSummary: Adds projectile trails to several vanilla weapons for visual flair.

mods.name: Trails of Tooth and Claw
mods.summary: After a substantial amount of work, I'm finally ready to launch the first public version of my new mod, Trails of Tooth and Claw

mods.name: Weebshit Extended
mods.summary: You already know you want this. Weebify the sector!
mods.aiSummary: Weebifies the sector.

mods.name: Weftin's Ship Pack
mods.summary: Adds 21 Midline ships (with some high tech flavor added in) to the sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 21 midline ships with high-tech flavor to the sector.

mods.name: Weird Portrait pack (55+17 pictures) (pictures added)
mods.summary: Weird stuff, in case your into it. Feel free to use it for whatever.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a collection of 72 character portraits, including 15 pony-themed images.

mods.name: Well Advised Modifications
mods.summary: Turns Ill Advised Modifications into a harmless flavor mod
mods.aiSummary: Turns Ill Advised Modifications into a harmless flavor mod.

mods.name: WH Rogue Trader Portrait Pack V1.0
mods.summary: This mod adds over 40 portraits from the game Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, playable characters, companions and some of the major characters, in addition to that there are also 3 portraits from the concept art of the game 40k Darktide.
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 40 character portraits from Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader and Darktide concept art for player use and faction encounters.

mods.name: What May Be Safely Written: The Eldest 0.1 (Conceptual WIP, LF Coder, Artist)
mods.displayName: What May Be Safely Written: The Eldest
mods.summary: It's a rarely shared but firmly held opinion of mine that no game is complete without a touch of cosmic horror, at least one appearance by things-that-should-not-be. So Here's my ongoing attempt at putting a bit of that sort of thing into Starfarer.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a cosmic horror-themed mission featuring new enemy ships and lore.

mods.name: What We Left Behind
mods.summary: This mod focuses on exploration and colony content, with a particular incline towards cosmic horror and esoteric nonsense. Various terrifying secrets exist in the reaches of the sector, waiting for you to discover them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds exploration and colony content focused on cosmic horror, including defense satellites, new terrain types, and interconnected world reactions.

mods.name: Which-industry
mods.summary: It's simple mod that adds to industry tooltip info from what mod industry/structure is
mods.aiSummary: Adds information to industry tooltips indicating which mod the industry or structure comes from.

mods.name: WhichMod
mods.summary: This mod adds the mod title to the descriptions of all weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods added by mods.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the originating mod's name to the descriptions of all weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods added by other mods.

mods.name: WhichTMI
mods.summary: WhichTMI adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player one way or another. This mod does not add anything fancy and is only intended to be used as a companion to TMI, or as a lightweight variation on it.
mods.aiSummary: Adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player one way or another.

mods.name: Whisper's Techmining Alterations
mods.summary: * Techmining is a structure, not infrastructure (since it doesn't benefit the faction/planet directly)
mods.aiSummary: Overhauls tech mining to treat it as a structure with decay mechanics, progress bars for special items, and highly configurable loot values.

mods.name: Wide Horizons
mods.summary: Wide Horizons lets you expand the Starsector galaxy by up to 300%. With in-game setting, the entire universe scales up: sector size, star systems, ruins, Remnants, gates, and more.
mods.aiSummary: Expands the galaxy size by up to 300% with scalable sectors, realistic system generation, and adjusted fuel and supply mechanics.

mods.name: Wingman Project: Online Combat Co-op battles for Starsector.(BETA)
mods.summary: Co-op multiplayer for Starsector battles. One player hosts a battle (a mission, the simulator or a campaign fight) and up to three friends(default, goes up to 16 but why would you do that?) join it, each flying a ship from the host's fleet, side by side, in real time.
mods.aiSummary: Adds co-op multiplayer to Starsector battles, allowing up to three friends to join a host's mission, simulator, or campaign fight in real time.

mods.name: WIP - Beyond The Black: a BSG and The Expanse inspired hard sci fi mod
mods.summary: A while back I wondered if Starsector could work with hard sci fi rules we see in Battlestar Galactica and The Expanse TV shows. So I created this mod to test it out, and it turned out pretty good.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a hard sci-fi combat system with five custom factions, unique ships, and overhauled weapons that remove shields and hard flux venting.

mods.name: WIP Aardwolf & Zenith: ARRUS Hullmods
mods.summary: A modest collection of additional hullmods to help customise the way you like to play. Most of the included hullmods are based off augmenting or offsetting a variety of vanilla hullmods. As such most of them have dependencies on vanilla hullmods and/or each other.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a suite of hullmods to augment, revert, or rectify vanilla and modded hullmod effects, including upgrade packages and diagnostic tools.

mods.name: Wishgranters Faction
mods.summary: The design philosophy behind the Wishgranters is thus:
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction featuring ships with small shields, heavy armor, and strong support wings that deliver massive volumes of fire.

mods.name: Wondrous Weapons
mods.summary: -A content expansion pack for Starsector, featuring many common ships, weapons, and (more content to come!)
mods.aiSummary: Adds a variety of new ships and weapons.

mods.name: World War
mods.summary: Adds a Chinese-language mod that requires separate language packs for translation.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a Chinese-language mod that requires separate language packs for translation.

mods.name: World War Mod
mods.summary: This is a complete chinese language mod! So, this mod gives those who can read chinese language. And I hope can find someone help me translate it into english language.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a Chinese-language overhaul featuring multi-satellite system maps, dynamic trade systems, ship ordering mechanics, and faction relationship management.

mods.name: Worldsmith Console Commands 1.3.0
mods.summary: Build worlds: planets, moons, rings, asteroid and debris fields, companion stars, or whole new star systems, black holes and neutron stars included. Bend orbits: push a planet farther out or speed it up, in percent, reverse it, or tidally lock a moon behind its planet.
mods.aiSummary: Adds console commands to build and modify planets, star systems, and factions, and to control 4X mechanics like war, peace, and colony expeditions.

mods.name: Wow Portraits
mods.summary: Ok, so it's not that WoW (World of Warcraft) kind of Portraits, but hear me out. This Mod aims to replace the Vanilla portraits and add some extra, to make the game feel more SciFi. As a Disclaimer: These portraits have been generated with Easy Stable Difussion, but trust me it was no easy task.
mods.aiSummary: Replaces vanilla character portraits with AI-generated sci-fi style images and adds new ones for various factions.

mods.name: XCOM Player Flags
mods.summary: Adds player flags inspired by XCOM and Long War.
mods.aiSummary: Adds player flags inspired by XCOM and Long War.

mods.name: Xhan Empire
mods.summary: Two factions, one a fully fledged militaristic and zealous faction focused on heavy armor and formation warfare. Ships and weapons that range from utilitarian to exotic with their own internally consistent design philosophy and tech levels.
mods.aiSummary: Adds two factions, the Xhan Empire and United Pamed, along with their unique ships, weapons, fighters, and exploration content.

mods.name: XIII Vanilla Ships
mods.summary: This submod includes only the vanilla 13th Battlegroup ships, sporting high armor, high forward speed, but a steep cost in maneuverability.
mods.aiSummary: Adds vanilla 13th Battlegroup ships with high armor and forward speed but reduced maneuverability.
mods.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98] Kon's Multi-Pack v.6.0.8 - 13th Battlegroup Player Faction

mods.name: XIII Weapons / Ships
mods.summary: This submod includes all 13th Battlegroup ships, sporting high armor, high forward speed, but a steep cost in maneuverability. Also included are a set of converted themed ballistic weaponry focused on extended magazines and themed fighter wings.
mods.aiSummary: Adds all 13th Battlegroup ships, themed ballistic weaponry, fighter wings, and rare blueprint bounties.
mods.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98] Kon's Multi-Pack v.6.0.8 - 13th Battlegroup Player Faction

mods.name: Xxarra's Variety Pack
mods.summary: Mod adds 60+ new ships, exploration and quest content, custom starts, multiple unique bounties, and additions to existing Vanilla content.
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 60 new ships, exploration and quest content, custom starts, and unique bounties.

mods.name: XXVII Battle group v0.9.7
mods.summary: Add a mid-tech battle group. Having some vanilla-like ships. Having some special faction weapons, but all of these are build-in their ships.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Shackles Garrison faction, featuring mid-tech ships with built-in specialized weapons and unique lore-driven missions.

mods.name: Yellow
mods.summary: The Ynadar Alliance was bit of an inside joke to complete the triad of the three primary color factions I was told to do.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction focused on midline armadas with increased base range for non-missile weapons and resistance to high explosives and beams.

mods.name: Yuki's Tactical Display
mods.summary: Adds a tactical display widget to the combat UI anchored to the left side of the screen, with configurable position. Shows your fleet along with their assignments and status, as well as flux bars and CR/PPT in visual form.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a configurable tactical display widget to the combat UI that shows fleet status, flux bars, and armor integrity, allowing players to issue orders directly from the widget.

mods.name: Yunru Mods
mods.summary: YunruCore is, in essence, a library mod for all my other mods. For me, it makes it easier to use programmes like the Ship and Weapon Editor, but for you the user, it allows you to enable and disable the other mods listed here at will without losing your saves.
mods.aiSummary: Acts as a library allowing users to enable and disable associated mods without losing saves.

mods.name: Yuri Expedition
mods.summary: This mod adds the new faction, Caparice Trade Co. in the Sola system in the eastern fringe of the sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Caparice Trade Co. faction with glass cannon missile ships and heavily armored bruisers.

mods.name: ZA WARUDO
mods.summary: Turns phase and temporal shell into a jojo reference.
mods.aiSummary: Turns phase and temporal shell abilities into a JoJo reference.

mods.name: Zer0Morph's Waving Banners
mods.summary: Turns all faction banners into something more... wavy
mods.aiSummary: Replaces faction banners with animated, waving versions for vanilla and player-made factions.

mods.name: Zoey's Faction Customization
mods.summary: Adds a few ways to customize your faction!
mods.aiSummary: Lets you change your faction color, fleet names, post/rank names, faction description, and illegal/legal commodities with mechanical effects.

mods.name: ZORG - - (Exerelin + Uomoz Compatible!) - Campaign Mode!
mods.summary: The ZORG mod adds a dozen new ships and weapons, plus new hullmods, portraits and ship systems. The campaign mode features a custom Zorg system, featuring unique celestial bodies, a Zorg station and spawnpoints. The Zorg spawn within their own system and spread out through hyperspace.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction of cybernetic AI-controlled ships, weapons, and hullmods with a custom campaign system.
